verdict.rationale: llamafile runs models entirely on the user's device with no cloud and no data sharing, and works fully offline. Its server sandbox blocks all outbound network connections, so user data structurally cannot reach any party for model training. A hands-on user also observed it executing with zero network connection. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user prompts and data are never used for training, rather than this being inferred from the local-only architecture.
